documentation.usageCode:
import {
  StepsRoot,
  StepsList,
  StepsItem,
  StepsTrigger,
  StepsIndicator,
  StepsSeparator,
  StepsContent,
  StepsCompleted,
} from '@uifn/components-react/steps'
import '@uifn/components/styles.css'

export function Example() {
  return (
    <StepsRoot count={3} defaultStep={1} aria-label="Steps example">
      <StepsList>
        <StepsItem value={0}>
          <StepsTrigger type="button" value={0}>Account</StepsTrigger>
          <StepsIndicator value={0}>1</StepsIndicator>
          <StepsSeparator value={0} />
        </StepsItem>
        <StepsItem value={1}>
          <StepsTrigger type="button" value={1}>Profile</StepsTrigger>
          <StepsIndicator value={1}>2</StepsIndicator>
          <StepsSeparator value={1} />
        </StepsItem>
        <StepsItem value={2}>
          <StepsTrigger type="button" value={2}>Review</StepsTrigger>
          <StepsIndicator value={2}>3</StepsIndicator>
          <StepsSeparator value={2} />
        </StepsItem>
      </StepsList>
      <StepsContent value={0}>Create your account.</StepsContent>
      <StepsContent value={1}>Complete your profile.</StepsContent>
      <StepsContent value={2}>Review and submit.</StepsContent>
      <StepsCompleted value={0}>Complete</StepsCompleted>
    </StepsRoot>
  )
}

generic.visibleText: ✓ Account 2 Profile 3 Review Complete your profile.
